steps.title: Establish Project Requirements
steps.description: Plan the Horse Care Companion app features, incorporating a multi-horse profile registry, equine feed & vet logger, riding workout timer, and a health guidance library.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) version 8.3.2, compile SDK 34, target SDK 34, and Java 8 compiler compatibility.

steps.title: Establish App Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml establishing the main launching activity, defining the package namespace com.horsecarecompanion.app, and setting the app icon reference.

steps.title: Design Equestrian-Themed UI Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout utilizing deep forest green and cream themes, and building an dynamic, easy-to-navigate tab bar containing Horse profiles, Care logs, Workout timers, and Guidelines.

steps.title: Initialize SQLite Database Scheme
steps.description: Implement a DatabaseHelper inside MainActivity.java to persist details for individual horses, daily care events, and training session durations.

steps.title: Implement Tab Switching Controller
steps.description: Develop high-performance tab switching logic in MainActivity.java to switch between Horse Stables, Care log, Timer, and Educational Guide layouts dynamically.

steps.title: Code Horse Registration Module
steps.description: Implement the core database methods to retrieve, insert, and delete registered horses. Set up visual alerts to inform horse owners of successful creation.

steps.title: Design Custom Addition Forms
steps.description: Code dynamic, robust Dialog forms inside MainActivity.java to allow the safe input of horse names, breeds, age, weight, and general health notes.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Card View Renderers
steps.description: Develop custom Java rendering code to dynamically create, layout, and insert beautiful profile card views for every horse stored in the SQLite database.

steps.title: Implement Daily Care Logger
steps.description: Implement the feeding and health logger module, allowing horse owners to track feeding intervals, farrier visits, worming schedule, and routine vaccines.

steps.title: Design Interactive Training Stopwatch
steps.description: Construct an equine session stopwatch using Android Handlers and Runnables to count training durations for activities like riding, lunging, and grooming.

steps.title: Implement Workout Log Saver
steps.description: Integrate workout stopwatch controls to save elapsed minutes/seconds directly into the local SQLite database for historical fitness analysis.

steps.title: Review Equine Medical Guideline Data
steps.description: Verify formatting of static advice cards summarizing standard horse vitals, feeding calculations, hoof practices, and colic warning signals.

steps.title: Perform Strict Input Validations
steps.description: Incorporate data input safety layers to verify age/weight formatting and prevent application crashes caused by missing horse names.

steps.title: Building Horse Care Companion
steps.description: Assemble the completed equestrian assets, package the XML resources, compile clean Java code, and build the Horse Care Companion debug APK.
